title: Data Analyst/Scientist
description:
Data Analyst/Scientist

Location: Windsor (3-4 days onsite)
Salary: Up to £60,000

An exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist to join a growing organisation and help develop its data and analytics capabilities.

Working within a small team, you will analyse complex datasets, improve data quality and deliver insights to support business decision-making.

Key responsibilities:

  • Analysing and interpreting data to identify trends and opportunities.

  • Developing data models, reports and dashboards.

  • Supporting forecasting and predictive analytics.

  • Improving data quality and reporting processes.

  • Working with stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions.

About you:

  • Strong SQL and analytical skills.

  • Experience in data analysis, modelling or data science.

  • Experience with forecasting and predictive analytics.

  • Exposure to Power BI and modern data platforms such as Snowflake.

  • STEM-related degree.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded, hands-on individual to join a growing team and make a real impact.
